world_first_claim: First constitutionally governed Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline for a local LLM governance assistant — corpus retrieval events are constitutional mutations, hash-chained to the LKSE ledger (INNOV-47), scored by CSS cosine similarity (INNOV-48), and injected into phi4's 32K context window (INNOV-49). Every grounded response is cryptographically linked to its corpus evidence.

new_hard_class.description: Every grounded response must cite >= 1 corpus entry; zero-citation responses are constitutionally prohibited
Context block must not exceed RAGS_MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS; overflow triggers logged truncation, never silent drop
Grounding ledger entries are HMAC-SHA256 hash-chained (prev_hash -> entry_hash); write failure raises RAGSLedgerWriteError
Each ledger entry must carry the LKSE corpus_entry_hash of every cited document (provenance bridge to INNOV-47)
If no corpus entry scores >= RAGS_MIN_COSINE_THRESHOLD, RAGS raises RAGSZeroGroundingError rather than pass empty context

trilogy_completion.INNOV-48: CSS — cosine semantic search over embedded corpus
trilogy_completion.INNOV-49: CMU — phi4:14b 32K context window, constitutional model upgrade
trilogy_completion.INNOV-50: RAGS — wires LKSE + CSS + CMU into governed grounded responses
